You run two fingers beside your weapon’s edge, leaving a line of fire along it, then strike with the burning blade.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Run a spark along your melee weapon and strike. Its appearance remains yours to choose.

Weak
2 physical and 1 fire damage.
Standard
2 physical and 1 fire damage; Burning 1.
Strong
3 physical and 2 fire damage; Burning 1.
